description:
This is a Sources Sought Notice/Request for Information (RFI).

Product Manager Combat Service Support Equipment (PdM CSSE), Marine Corps Systems Command (MARCORSYSCOM), is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of providing a suite of Hearing Enhancement Devices (NAICS - 334220 and PSC - 8470 apply). 

Please see the attachment for additional information.

*Note - 03 April 2026 - This post was updated to include the attached Q&As.
